bodyCopyEvidence: apps/storefront/src/main.tsx renders product.category marketing text at line75, not merely an image/title/price card. C rows are required for its proposed fresh-copy replacement.
sectionIntroPolicy: Existing static intro retained as visible metadata; any future personalized intro needs an additional generated row/version.
exactNameQueryPolicy: Always return catalog originalName visibly; explicit complete catalog names in public task and optional trusted resolved product IDs must be present. Ambiguous/partial name resolution is not implemented.
titlePolicy: Current factuality/identity/novelty/support mandatory; displaying originalName does not relax generated-title identity. A subtitle-bound title policy must be a separate prospective version.

timing.formulaLowerBound: measured planningPrefixMs + max(completedMs of ALL ten required rows)
timing.finalReceipt: validatedAndSerializedAtMs >= lowerBound and metadataReadyAtMs, bound to completed payload SHA256
timing.withoutFinalReceipt: payload-ready unavailable; last-required-token lower bound only

existingIntegrationLimits: Current PagePlanV1 has no per-card body-copy field; STB decoder codec does not accept C labels. This is an additive model-only benchmark contract, not an API or UI change.
Existing 14-row runs omit C1/C2/C3 and cannot qualify as this complete payload.
Native decode_rows currently decodes text only after all rows finish; EOS completion is not actual scoped payload availability.
Current storefront renders CSS ProductArt and is not wired to model-selected imageKeys; no real image/render readiness claim.
The first three-card collection scope is logical and fixed, not a claim that all cards fit the current viewport beneath the hero.
Full-page validation remains unchanged. Below-fold failure cannot invalidate a separately completed valid scoped payload.
No conversion, revenue or human preference lift is established; synthetic correctness and latency are proxies.
